cand.title: EuroLFT Town Hall Meeting & Workshop on Lattice Field Theory and AI
cand.organizationName: European Lattice Field Theory community / CERN
cand.excerpt: Strong official event evidence and credible scientific/education demand mechanism; venue commitment prevents treating it as open inventory.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Two relevant relationship contacts, not verified purchasing signatories: Harvey Byron Meyer, named event chairperson and CERN Theory researcher, for the local organizing interface; Gert Aarts, named event chairperson and EuroLFT Executive Board member since 2025, for community leadership and future meeting plans. Neither source establishes hotel-contract authority. The event secretariat is the clearest first operational routing point.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming within the requested horizon: 31 March 2027 08:00–2 April 2027 18:00, Europe/Zurich. Current official title is European Lattice Field Theory Community Meeting & Workshop on Lattice Field Theory and AI. Community meeting: 31 March–1 April morning; AI workshop: 1 April afternoon–2 April. Programme remains in preparation; registration is expected to open in mid-November 2026, with no registration fee. No later edition with official dates and venue was located; do not create a 2028 edition.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel specifications: YOTEL Geneva Lake is a conditional off-site lodging proposition, not the meeting venue. Founex is distinct from the Meyrin campus; airport-corridor positioning alone does not demonstrate convenient daily CERN access. Require a credible transfer plan and acceptable participant pricing before proposing a block. Published 2027 attendance, peak rooms and room-nights are absent, so neither too-large nor too-small can be established and the hotel’s 20–120-room commercial band is not a demand estimate. Six meeting rooms, rooftop and resort-style retreat attributes are not demonstrated requirements of this CERN-based programme. Do not pitch the whole 237-room house.
findings.venueCommitments: Published venue: CERN, 4/3-006 – TH Conference Room, building 4, Meyrin, Canton of Geneva, Switzerland. Main entrance: Esplanade des Particules 1, 1217 Meyrin. Geographic classification: Geneva Airport-side/Meyrin CERN campus, not Geneva city centre, Founex/Nyon/La Côte or Lausanne. This is an announced scientific-campus venue commitment, not evidence of a hotel contract or an open meeting RFP.
findings.historicalRotation: A related predecessor is verified on 5–6 March 2020: European lattice community HPC access town-hall meeting, Salmon lecture theatre, School of Mathematics, Hamilton Building, Trinity College Dublin, Dublin 2, Ireland. A network progress report says it led to the EuroLat consortium; EuroLFT identifies itself as formerly EuroLAT. This establishes lineage, not an uninterrupted edition series or a Dublin–CERN rotation policy. An LHP letter of intent proposes yearly EuroLFT town meetings and anticipates some activities at CERN, ECT* and Mainz; these are intentions, not confirmed past hosts or future allocations.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Unknown for the 2027 edition: no edition-specific housing bureau, named commercial hotel, room block, booking form or open hotel RFP was located. The edition-specific directions state: "If you have a room in the hostel and arrive on Sunday evening, the guards at the CERN main entrance (B) will have your name on the guest list. Please bring your reservation confirmation." They identify hostel buildings 38, 39 and 41. The CERN hostel is therefore mentioned as an accommodation option, but this conditional arrival guidance is not a block commitment or evidence of availability. No commercial hotels are named on the retrieved 2027 pages. Other CERN workshops’ housing arrangements must not be transferred to this edition. Published support route: THworkshops.secretariat@cern.ch.
findings.organizationStructure: EuroLFT describes itself as a body representing the European Lattice Field Theory community, formerly EuroLAT, and as a European network for lattice field theory. The official event is supported by Hadron 2030 and CERN Theory, hosted at CERN, with named scientific chairpersons and CERN workshop-secretariat support. Treat as a scientific-community event rather than a proven incorporated association, corporate event or agency-led programme. No external PCO/DMC or housing bureau is identified in the reviewed edition material; legal contracting entity remains unverified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: The announced CERN conference room removes the main meeting-space opportunity. CERN hostel accommodation is mentioned but neither its allocated stock nor uptake is published. No commercial incumbent hotel, exclusivity, sold-out condition, overflow demand or unmet room requirement is verified. Edition directions say "The CERN shuttle service does NOT operate at this time" and describe airport/public-transport access; this is not a YOTEL transfer service. Inference: campus convenience and transport friction may limit Founex conversion.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Email THworkshops.secretariat@cern.ch with a short accommodation-only qualification enquiry for 31 March–2 April 2027, requesting routing to the local organizer, potentially Harvey Meyer. Ask whether hostel rooms are blocked, who arranges external lodging, expected non-local overnight participants, arrival/departure pattern, budget and transfer requirements, and whether hotel proposals are welcome. Only after a positive response offer a demand-sized allocation with an explicit CERN transport solution, not an assumed 20–120-room block. Separately approach Gert Aarts about future workshop planning and the actual venue decision process; do not send an unsolicited full-venue replacement bid.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: For the selected 2027 edition, scientific participation is announced and registration is expected in mid-November 2026; this does not establish supplier access. Meeting location is already announced at CERN. Hotel sourcing is unconfirmed, not open and not proven committed elsewhere. A lodging enquiry is commercially permissible only as qualification outreach, not a qualified room-block lead.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: maintain a relationship for future off-site workshops, small organizing-group stays or accommodation referrals if the community confirms a need. The LHP letter of intent explicitly proposes yearly EuroLFT town meetings, but no later dated edition or venue-selection process was located. CERN, ECT* and Mainz are anticipated locations for some broader LHP activities, not confirmed EuroLFT rotation stops. Do not book projected 2028 demand or assume the 2027 CERN meeting is relocatable.
